reasons.phone: NIGERIAN RESTAURANT JOLLOF, SUYA, EGUSI over a glazed shopfront, sash windows above: a London shop terrace in one look.
reasons.silhouette: The front (three shopfronts, sashes, cornice) says a terrace; the back is a wall of black openings and the sides are blank gables: two of four.
reasons.proportion: Three storeys, sashes, shop doors and the person agree.
reasons.palette: The stock-brick ochre is a flat colour close to the stage's sand, with no brick courses; the shop boards and dark glass carry it.
reasons.wear: A dish, a downpipe, curtains in some windows; no bins, no stains under sills, no shutter, no grime at the shopfronts.
reasons.variety: Plainly the same family and its own: the first London building.
